prompt_fragment: This asset is a sprite. Keep the silhouette clean and readable, with one clear focal subject and strong separation from the background.
raw_description:
A tattered heraldic banner mounted on a bone-and-volcanic-glass pole. The
sigil carved into the banner is an incomplete name using a ☽ moon-
truncation mark. Swallowtail fly torn at the hem; pole blackened with old
soot. Small chip-scars from a dozen campaigns. Rendered on warm-cream
parchment with the banner filling the frame vertically.
formatted_prompt: Editorial ink-and-watercolor illustration, richly pigmented, game-poster saturation on warm-cream aged parchment with faint foxing at the edges. A vertical swallowtail heraldic banner mounted on a blackened bone-and-volcanic-glass pole fills the frame, the pole scarred with old soot and small chip-marks from long campaigns. The banner's charcoal-grey field is embroidered with ember-thread stitching that glows vivid orange at the fraying edges; the central sigil is an incomplete name rendered in faux-Latin script with a prominent ☽ moon-truncation mark, carved deep into the cloth in obsidian black linework. The swallowtail fly is torn and ragged at the hem, crimson fire-core lining visible through the splits. Bioluminescent cold blue-green glyphs pulse faintly along the pole's shaft. Deep shadow behind the pole creates strong silhouette separation. Lighting is warm ember-orange from below, cool cyan rim from the ice above.
